in.other_title: Theorem constrains this Rogue Eval monitor
in.rationale: Local branch checks do not cover the whole Inspect execution path.

out.rationale: The candidate composition passes a monitor to DTT.
out.scope: basic_monitor_builder is only the default monitor of defer_to_trusted_builder (its default_factory); DTT defers when the monitor's suspicion_score is greater than defer_threshold (default 0.5), and the basic monitor normalises its score to the range 0 to 1 only by default. The DTT routing audit ran with fake policies, a fake monitor and fake state, with no model or Inspect runtime, while the basic monitor scores tool calls using a separate model; routing on the basic monitor's model-generated scores is untested in this composition.

out.rationale: The local trace exercises selected exact DTT, monitor, upload, and side-scorer bodies with deterministic stand-ins.
out.scope: The trace covers four constructed fixture episodes for one Rogue Eval simple task, with no sampling distribution; it runs no model and has no Inspect AI runtime or Docker. The monitor's raw fixture score is normalised by a fixture adapter (linear 0..10 to 0..1), and the upstream extractor is not executed. The trace is not a safety rate or system certification.

rules: Every record and link keeps its recorded state; most are PROPOSED (AI-drafted, unreviewed). Say so when you use them.
A link is a recorded connection, not a verified relationship. An empty path_eligibility means the link may not be chained to carry a result into another setting.
Cite the paper and the PDF page in the record's sources, and check the paper before relying on a claim.
Counts are indexed records, not distinct ideas or papers. Absence of a record is a gap in the atlas, not evidence that nothing exists.
state_meaning: Tied to an exact source location; not reviewed for meaning.
text: Source takes the trusted policy's action only when the monitor's suspicion score is strictly greater than defer_threshold (default 0.5); the local branch audit tests local Python routing only, not actual model output, Inspect tool execution, or safety of the trusted policy.
